description: Every diagram must have at least one start event
message: No start event found. Add a 'start [id] "[Label]"' declaration.

description: Every diagram must have at least one end event
message: No end event found. Add an 'end [id] "[Label]"' declaration.

description: All flow source IDs must reference a declared element
message: Flow source '[id]' is not a declared element. Declare the element before the flow, or correct the ID.

description: All flow target IDs must reference a declared element
message: Flow target '[id]' is not a declared element. Declare the element before the flow, or correct the ID.

description: XOR gateways must have at least two outgoing sequence flows
check: for each xor: count(flows where source=xor.id) >= 2
message: XOR gateway '[id]' has fewer than 2 outgoing flows. Add a second outgoing flow with a condition label.

description: XOR gateway outgoing flows must each have a condition label
check: for each xor: all outgoing flows have a label
message: XOR gateway '[id]' has an outgoing flow without a condition label. Add a label: '[source] --> [target]: "condition"'.

description: Every declared element must appear in at least one flow (no orphan elements)
check: every element.id appears in at least one flow as source or target
message: Element '[id]' ([keyword]) is an orphan — it does not appear in any flow. Connect it to the process flow.

description: Sequence flows must not cross pool boundaries
check: for each --> flow: source.poolId == target.poolId or source.poolId is null or target.poolId is null
message: Sequence flow from '[source]' to '[target]' crosses a pool boundary. Use a '~~>' message flow at the top level instead.

description: Pool and lane brackets must be balanced (all opened blocks must be closed)
message: Unbalanced brackets: [n] block(s) were opened but not closed. Add the missing '}' for each open pool or lane block.

description: All element and flow labels must be enclosed in double quotes
check: every label token is a double-quoted string
message: Label '[value]' is not double-quoted. Wrap it in double quotes: "[value]".

description: Reserved keywords must not be used as element IDs
check: no element ID is in the reserved keyword list
message: ID '[id]' is a reserved keyword and cannot be used as an element ID. Rename it (e.g., '[id]_node' or a semantic name).

description: AND (parallel) gateway splits must have a corresponding AND join, unless parallel paths each terminate in separate end events
check: for each and-gateway with 2+ outgoing flows: there exists an and-gateway with 2+ incoming flows that re-merges all split paths, or all split paths end in separate end events
message: AND split gateway '[id]' may be missing a corresponding AND join. Verify parallel paths are properly rejoined or each ends in a separate end event.
